summary.text: Dave Nagel is a Democratic state representative from Belknap 6 who has served in the House since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Nagel is a physician who specialized in physical medicine and rehabilitation.

paragraphs.text: David Nagel lives in Gilmanton, New Hampshire, and holds a bachelor's degree from Hamilton College and an M.D. from the University of Rochester School of Medicine.
His career experience includes working as a physician, especially as a specialist in physical medicine and rehabilitation.
Ballotpedia says he founded the New Hampshire Pain Collaborative, served as president of the Nagel Pain Community and joined the U.S. Pain Foundation as a member.
